title: Echo of Tyros
summary: The frozen notes say the god's oldest fire still burns: the Echo of Tyros, in a Nether Citadel. Find the Citadel and kill two Ancient Knights for Cinder Essence. Craft a Cinderous Soulcaller (4 Cinder Essence, 2 Netherite Scrap, the Echo Shard from the mountain tower) and ring it at the Citadel's glowing rune to summon Tyros. Then put him out.

goals.say: Ancient Knights drop Cinder Essence. You need four, plus the Echo Shard and two Netherite Scrap, to craft a Cinderous Soulcaller.
As it gutters out, Tyros whispers: 'He gave me this fire. Tell him it went out.'
